name: PlanetScale
shortDescription: MySQL-compatible serverless database with non-blocking schema changes and branching workflows.
description: MySQL-compatible database built on Vitess, offering non-blocking schema changes, horizontal scaling, and branch-based workflows for safe migrations.
We use PlanetScale for production-grade relational workloads that need MySQL semantics, strong reliability, and developer-friendly branching.
Licensing notes: Managed MySQL (Vitess). Data export and branching facilitate migration when needed.
